text:
maya_chen: quick async standup — onboarding llm-qa-3b-quant
what I did: ran 100 sample evals on internal QA set, pushed quantized weights to staging, added prompt variations v2
blockers: seeing intermittent hallucinations on long contexts (>4k tokens), KV-cache mismatch on dedupe test, need 👀 on prompt conditioning
today: debug KV cache path, run full regression suite, open PR for prompt fixes

chris_r: thanks maya. can you paste a minimal failing example? :eyes:

maya_chen: here's a short repro snippet:
```
input: "Find the date of the 1998 summit"
context: (4.5k tokens, truncated)
output: "June 12, 1999"
```
behaviour suggests off-by-one in truncation or a tokenization window mismatch.

alex_k: could be tokenizer config mismatch — try `scripts/tokenize_check.py --model llm-qa-3b-quant --sample 12` and share the diffs. also check `tokenizer.vocab_size` in the compiled artifact.

maya_chen: running tokenize_check now, will paste output in a sec.

sam_p: FYI eval-bot flagged a regression for prompt_set:v2 vs baseline(v1) — ExactMatch down ~4.6%. pinned v1 as fallback on prod route to be safe. :thumbsup:

eval-bot: [automated] Regression alert: prompt_set:v2 vs baseline(v1) — metric: ExactMatch delta -4.6% (p<0.01). affected slices: legal-qa, long-context.

chris_r: re: KV cache, I remember a runtime change that switched `cache_key` encoding to little-endian. try enabling `--kv-compat true` in staging to see if it fixes alignment with old checkpoints.

maya_chen: good call. testing `--kv-compat true` now on staging. also left draft PR #342 for prompt wording tweaks (clarify temporal anchors). cc @alex_k for review.

alex_k: I'll take a look tonight. small suggestion for PR: include the eval diff table and a couple of failing examples inline to speed review.

maya_chen: will update PR with diffs and example traces.

chris_r: happy to pair tomorrow if helpful.

maya_chen: anyone free 10:00–10:30am PST for a pairing session to walk KV traces + eval harness?
sam_p: I can do 10am PST.

chris_r: +1 for 10am PST.

maya_chen: great — will send calendar invite and attach staging logs. thanks all — will post updates here after the KV run and tokenize_check results.
__notes: thread written in realistic slack style; short messages, mentions, emoji, code block, bot alert.
